name: पॅन कार्ड
description: PAN is a 10-character alphanumeric identifier issued for all tax-related and high-value financial transactions.
benefits: Mandatory for filing income tax returns, opening bank accounts, and high-value transactions.
eligibility: Individuals, companies, HUFs, and entities carrying out financial transactions in India.
steps: Visit the Income Tax e-filing portal.
Select 'Instant e-PAN' (Aadhaar-based) or apply via NSDL/UTIITSL.
Enter Aadhaar number and validate OTP.
